notes.model: Dense Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct. Same 7-view protocol as the 8B run.
notes.activation_layers: Eight evenly spaced language blocks from ~1/8 depth through the last of 64.
notes.compute_canada: Download on a login node into $SCRATCH/huggingface then run the GPU job with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1. BF16 weights are ~65 GB; use an A100/H100 80GB. On 40 GB use --quant nf4.
